placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Tyntesfield combines a distinctive Victorian house with gardens and a wider landscape to explore. For a family outing, the estate paths and play areas can be the focus rather than trying to fit every part of the property into one day.

Our family idea: choose two stops from the visitor map and let children help decide the order. A short walk between a garden and a play area leaves plenty of time to pause and notice small details.
